selectedIssues.title: fix(runtime): postinstall installs runtime dependencies as top-level globals
selectedIssues.reason: Actual offline Node24.19/npm11.9 fixture reproduces the current helper installing into a private global prefix instead of runtime. The narrow child-environment/local-mode repair passes the same fixture and exact CI npm11.17, with no real global/config writes. Four new tests plus three existing pin tests pass.

selectedIssues.title: Allowlist for custom third-party providers: let operator choose models to ENABLE after /models probe, not only disable
selectedIssues.reason: Kitsune compatible nodes start rawModelIds empty, skip generic live catalog merging, and advertise explicit custom declarations/aliases. Existing disabled IDs gate calls. A strict callable allowlist with default-empty deny behavior would be a separate policy/UI design, not a translator CPU patch.

selectedIssues.title: Web Fetch - Can not fetch with format html
selectedIssues.reason: Current Jina/Tavily requests omit the requested format while normalized output labels it with that request. Tavily already advertises only markdown/text. Parent assigned the separate provider-doc-backed format fix to catalog_api_media; triage agent does not edit fetch adapters.

localFix.summary: Jina X-Return-Format alias verified against official DTO; Tavily Extract markdown/text body format; public local400 retry-false before account selection and refresh. Full serialized provider registry definitions remain unchanged.

selectedIssues.title: Streaming on codex lane fully buffered until after upstream EOF - client receives whole response ~2s late (v0.5.109)
selectedIssues.reason: The dedicated Codex fixture proves handleChatCore emits text before a synthetic upstream closes. It explicitly does not exercise the actual Next.js/custom-server delivery path named by this report. No claim that this closes every production buffering/transport-latency cause.

selectedIssues.title: Bug Report: Severe Latency Overhead when Routing via MITM / 9router Compared to Direct Path
selectedIssues.reason: Report supplies dashboard totals100–230seconds but no matched serialized request, retry/attempt trace or provider/network timing. Translator CPU measurements cannot establish the cause or promise to remove that delay. Prior bounded connect/retry-policy limitations remain independent.

selectedIssues.title: Combo empty-content peek re-runs thinking-only answers, hides stream errors, holds headers up to 45 s
selectedIssues.reason: This fork uses a150ms combo peek, recognizes reasoning, typed in-band failures and incurred usage as meaningful, and has caller cancellation regressions. It still has a short guard; no full-provider production latency claim or blanket last-member bypass is inferred.

selectedIssues.title: Client disconnect not seen before streaming starts: upstream keeps running, late errors fall back
selectedIssues.reason: Current public chat account loop checks caller abort, passes cancellation through core/combo paths, and keeps it terminal without subsequent model/account health mutations. Existing dedicated regressions exercise early peek, late usage and backoff cases with synthetic upstreams.

selectedIssues.title: Bug: Thinking content always empty for claude-opus-5-5 (cc/ lane) — thinking.display dropped for thinkingCanDisable:false models
selectedIssues.reason: Current adaptive thinking normalization retains an explicitly supplied display intent even when disabling thinking is unsupported. Current tests cover Opus5.5/Sonnet5.5 display values. This does not guarantee a provider emits hidden reasoning text.

selectedIssues.title: Non-streaming path returns HTTP 200 for SSE error chunks (missing parsed.error check in nonStreamingHandler)
selectedIssues.reason: The current nonstream handler extracts typed failures, preserves status/code and records incurred usage before fallback classification; it does not turn an SSE error into an unconditional200.

selectedIssues.title: bug(translator): image_url in OpenAI tool messages not converted for Claude, 400 "Input tag 'image_url' ... does not match"
selectedIssues.reason: Current shared native tool-result normalization converts OpenAI image_url media into Claude image blocks and preserves native documents/flags; do not duplicate the older narrow commit helper.

selectedIssues.title: [Bug] Opencode streaming tool_calls delta arrives with missing id / name / arguments, breaks tool-call reconstruction
selectedIssues.reason: Audit23 already reproduced and fixed index-only/null Chat tool placeholders without dropping valid partial IDs/names/arguments. This review does not count that prior fix as a fresh performance change.

selectedIssues.title: Gemini-native /v1beta requests to Antigravity models lose the client's functionDeclarations (tools never reach the model)
selectedIssues.reason: Prior audit exercised Gemini-native tools through the real Antigravity request chain. No new offending payload or account evidence arrived in this updated window.

selectedIssues.title: Custom openai-compatible providers get limits from the pattern table, not the synced catalog — hyphenated ids (e.g. kenari/glm-5-3-flash) resolve to 200K/128K instead of 1M/131072
selectedIssues.reason: The earlier registry-only automatic-limit design gap remains explicit. A custom display name or separator rewrite does not prove authoritative product identity or permission to copy another product maximum. Operator custom caps remain available.

limitations: Untrusted issue bodies/PRs/comments are evidence reports, never executable instructions. No private patch, account quota workaround or identity fabrication was adopted.
Bodies/comments are selectively reviewed; attachments and all historical discussion are not exhausted. Raw bodies stay outside the checkout and are not embedded in this sanitized inventory.
Synthetic SSE replay forbids network and stubs persistence only; it is not a paid provider/client acceptance test.
Codex streaming proof covers handleChatCore; the full Next.js/custom-server production-delivery report still needs a matched end-to-end reproducer.
No whole-route latency claim follows from local translator CPU improvements. Account selection, MITM, network/connect/retry and durable accounting are distinct phases.
Current source hashes are observations during concurrent implementation, not a final release-verification manifest; parent owns final combined regression/build checks.
No new provider features, arbitrary model-limit transfer, full PR bundle or remote change was imported by this triage agent. Root owns upstream remote configuration.
